summary: ClinicalIDCardEditAll is an ASP.NET Web UserControl providing grid-based editing for student Clinical ID Card details. It enables bulk editing, filtering, and saving of ID card information per student enrollment, governed by a variety of conditions and business rules.
purpose: To allow administrators to view, filter, and edit Clinical ID Card details for multiple students in batch, handling workflows such as issuing, saving, and tracking ID cards across cohorts, terms, and courses.

workflows.name: Bulk Clinical ID Card Edit
steps: User filters grid using Cohort, Term, Course, Section, Action, Campus, Keyword, Comment, and Show options.
Grid loads and displays student records; user may sort by columns.
Administrator edits ID card details per student.
Save operations enabled/disabled depending on EnrollmentID and row count.
User invokes Save, Save All, or Save Edit Next command.
System validates changes, updates student details via StudentDetailsSafetyIDCardUpdate.
Page may redirect upon completion, governed by warning messages and Session.

workflows.name: Data Selection and Binding
steps: dsCRC ObjectDataSource pulls filtered enrollment data based on control properties.
GridView binds data; header/footer controls and Save buttons adjust visibility based on context.
If user session is invalid, data selection is cancelled.

business_rules: Save buttons displayed/hidden based on row count and EnrollmentID.
If in Add or single Edit mode (EnrollmentID != 0), Save All button is hidden in header.
If less than 14 rows (no scroll bars), Save All and Cancel buttons are hidden.
Save actions update only rows marked dirty.
Redirect only occurs if session warning messages count < 1.
validations: ValidationSummary control used for displaying validation errors.
Page disables edit fields and calendar controls if blnReadOnly is true.
User session required for datasource operations; selection cancelled if not present.
calculations: Session query strings used to build redirect URLs with dynamic filter/sort parameters.
StartRow incremented by PageSize for pagination in redirect.
conditions: blnReadOnly disables edit fields and calendar controls.
EnrollmentID governs whether Save All or Save buttons are enabled and which rows are editable.
If Session returns warnings, redirect is suppressed.
system_behavior: JavaScript variables setup per row for dirty tracking.
Grid disables edit fields, hides buttons, and configures controls based on context.
On Save operations, system iterates grid rows, checks for dirty, updates only changed records.
Data binding cancels if session is invalid.
dependencies: Grid utility functions (DisableEditFields, HideButtons, GetStringFromHiddenField, GetValueFromCheckBox, GetStringFromTextBox)
exceptions: If user session is null, datasource selection is cancelled.
If warnings detected in UserSession, redirect after Save is suppressed.
content_gaps: No explicit field-level validation rules found in source.
Actual database schema and update logic for StudentDetailsSafetyIDCardUpdate not detailed.
No explicit UI layout or styling information present.
